name: PityLoot
teaser: Can't find that one quest item? Every raid without it makes it more likely to spawn. Pity loot for quests, hideout upgrades, quest keys and Gunsmith parts.
description:
This is a C# rewrite for SPT 4.1 of Bakahashi’s PityLoot for SPT 3.x, with the same features and config.

By default only raids where you die or go MIA count. Set onlyIncreaseOnFailedRaids to false to count every raid. You can also switch to a time-based mode that grows per real-world hour instead of per raid.
